interface.shortDescription: Direct your film with source-grounded creative choices.
interface.longDescription: REMAKE by objekts is a source-grounded filmmaking workshop for any combination or count of creative materials. Its stateless public MCP can return selected PNG/JPEG images to AI hosts (up to 8 per transport call), preserve source metadata, and compile unapproved project drafts. Security: the unauthenticated public project revision tool now refuses approvals, rejections, LOCK changes, forged model observations, and actor claims until a real verified human consent mechanism is connected. No cross-chat accounts or independent film-quality validation yet.
